Hallelujah! Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
Let the Lord be praised. O give praise to the Lord, for he is good: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.
你們要讚美耶和華！要稱謝耶和華，因他本為善；他的慈愛永遠長存！
Who can describe the mighty acts of the LORD or fully proclaim His praise?
Who is able to give an account of the great acts of the Lord, or to make clear all his praise?
誰能傳說耶和華的大能？誰能表明他一切的美德？
Blessed are those who uphold justice, who practice righteousness at all times.
Happy are they whose decisions are upright, and he who does righteousness at all times.
凡遵守公平、常行公義的，這人便為有福！
Remember me, O LORD, in Your favor to Your people; visit me with Your salvation,
Keep me in mind, O Lord, when you are good to your people; O let your salvation come to me;
耶和華啊，你用恩惠待你的百姓；求你也用這恩惠記念我，開你的救恩眷顧我，
that I may see the prosperity of Your chosen ones, and rejoice in the gladness of Your nation, and give glory with Your inheritance.
So that I may see the well-being of the people of your selection, and have a part in the joy of your nation, and take pride in your heritage.
使我見你選民的福，樂你國民的樂，與你的產業一同誇耀。
We have sinned like our fathers; we have done wrong and acted wickedly.
We are sinners like our fathers, we have done wrong, our acts are evil.
我們與我們的祖宗一同犯罪；我們作了孽，行了惡。
Our fathers in Egypt did not grasp Your wonders or remember Your abundant kindness; but they rebelled by the sea, there at the Red Sea.
Our fathers did not give thought to your wonders in Egypt; they did not keep in memory the great number of your mercies, but gave you cause for wrath at the sea, even at the Red Sea.
我們的祖宗在埃及不明白你的奇事，不記念你豐盛的慈愛，反倒在紅海行了悖逆。
Yet He saved them for the sake of His name, to make His power known.
But he was their saviour because of his name, so that men might see his great power.
然而，他因自己的名拯救他們，為要彰顯他的大能，
He rebuked the Red Sea, and it dried up; He led them through the depths as through a desert.
By his word the Red Sea was made dry: and he took them through the deep waters as through the waste land.
並且斥責紅海，海便乾了；他帶領他們經過深處，如同經過曠野。
He saved them from the hand that hated them; He redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
And he took them safely out of the hands of their haters, and kept them from the attacks of those who were against them.
他拯救他們脫離恨他們人的手，從仇敵手中救贖他們。
The waters covered their foes; not one of them remained.
And the waters went over their haters; all of them came to an end.
水淹沒他們的敵人，沒有一個存留。
Then they believed His promises and sang His praise.
Then they had faith in his words; they gave him songs of praise.
那時，他們才信了他的話，歌唱讚美他。
Yet they soon forgot His works and failed to wait for His counsel.
But their memory of his works was short; not waiting to be guided by him,
等不多時，他們就忘了他的作為，不仰望他的指教，
They craved intensely in the wilderness and tested God in the desert.
They gave way to their evil desires in the waste land, and put God to the test in the dry places.
反倒在曠野大起慾心，在荒地試探神。
So He granted their request, but sent a wasting disease upon them.
And he gave them their request, but sent a wasting disease into their souls.
他將他們所求的賜給他們，卻使他們的心靈軟弱。
In the camp they envied Moses, as well as Aaron, the holy one of the LORD.
They were full of envy against Moses among the tents, and against Aaron, the holy one of the Lord.
他們又在營中嫉妒摩西和耶和華的聖者亞倫。
The earth opened up and swallowed Dathan; it covered the assembly of Abiram.
The earth opening put an end to Dathan, covering up Abiram and his band.
地裂開，吞下大坍，掩蓋亞比蘭一黨的人。
Then fire blazed through their company; flames consumed the wicked.
And a fire was lighted among their tents; the sinners were burned up by the flames.
有火在他們的黨中發起；有火焰燒毀了惡人。
At Horeb they made a calf and worshiped a molten image.
They made a young ox in Horeb, and gave worship to an image of gold.
他們在何烈山造了牛犢，叩拜鑄成的像。
They exchanged their Glory for the image of a grass-eating ox.
And their glory was changed into the image of an ox, whose food is grass.
如此將他們榮耀的主換為吃草之牛的像，
They forgot God their Savior, who did great things in Egypt,
They had no memory of God their saviour, who had done great things in Egypt;
忘了神─他們的救主；他曾在埃及行大事，
wondrous works in the land of Ham, and awesome deeds by the Red Sea.
Works of wonder in the land of Ham, and things of fear by the Red Sea.
在含地行奇事，在紅海行可畏的事。
So He said He would destroy them— had not Moses His chosen one stood before Him in the breach to divert His wrath from destroying them.
And he was purposing to put an end to them if Moses, his special servant, had not gone up before him, between him and his people, turning back his wrath, to keep them from destruction.
所以，他說要滅絕他們；若非有他所揀選的摩西站在當中（原文是破口），使他的忿怒轉消，恐怕他就滅絕他們。
They despised the pleasant land; they did not believe His promise.
They were disgusted with the good land; they had no belief in his word;
他們又藐視那美地，不信他的話，
They grumbled in their tents and did not listen to the voice of the LORD.
Talking against him secretly in their tents, they did not give ear to the voice of the Lord.
在自己帳棚內發怨言，不聽耶和華的聲音。
So He raised His hand and swore to cast them down in the wilderness,
So he made an oath against them, to put an end to them in the waste land:
所以，他對他們起誓：必叫他們倒在曠野，
to disperse their offspring among the nations and scatter them throughout the lands.
That their children might be mixed among the nations, and sent away into other lands.
叫他們的後裔倒在列國之中，分散在各地。
They yoked themselves to Baal of Peor and ate sacrifices offered to lifeless gods.
And they were joined to Baal-peor, and took part in the offerings to the dead.
他們又與巴力•毘珥連合，且吃了祭死神（或譯：人）的物。
So they provoked the LORD to anger with their deeds, and a plague broke out among them.
So they made him angry by their behaviour; and he sent disease on them.
他們這樣行，惹耶和華發怒，便有瘟疫流行在他們中間。
But Phinehas stood and intervened, and the plague was restrained.
Then Phinehas got up, and made prayer for them; and the disease went no farther.
那時，非尼哈站起，刑罰惡人，瘟疫這才止息。
It was credited to him as righteousness for endless generations to come.
And all the generations coming after him kept the memory of his righteousness for ever.
那就算為他的義，世世代代，直到永遠。
At the waters of Meribah they angered the LORD, and trouble came to Moses because of them.
They made God angry again at the waters of Meribah, so that Moses was troubled because of them;
他們在米利巴水又叫耶和華發怒，甚至摩西也受了虧損，
For they rebelled against His Spirit, and Moses spoke rashly with his lips.
For they made his spirit bitter, and he said unwise things.
是因他們惹動他的靈，摩西（原文是他）用嘴說了急躁的話。
They did not destroy the peoples as the LORD had commanded them,
They did not put an end to the peoples, as the Lord had said;
他們不照耶和華所吩咐的滅絕外邦人，
but they mingled with the nations and adopted their customs.
But they were joined to the nations, learning their works.
反與他們混雜相合，學習他們的行為，
They worshiped their idols, which became a snare to them.
And they gave worship to images; which were a danger to them:
事奉他們的偶像，這就成了自己的網羅，
They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.
They even made offerings of their sons and their daughters to evil spirits,
把自己的兒女祭祀鬼魔，
They shed innocent blood— the blood of their sons and daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan, and the land was polluted with blood.
And gave the blood of their sons and their daughters who had done no wrong, offering them to the images of Canaan; and the land was made unclean with blood.
流無辜人的血，就是自己兒女的血，把他們祭祀迦南的偶像，那地就被血污穢了。
They defiled themselves by their actions and prostituted themselves by their deeds.
So they became unclean through their works, going after their evil desires.
這樣，他們被自己所做的污穢了，在行為上犯了邪淫。
So the anger of the LORD burned against His people, and He abhorred His own inheritance.
Then the wrath of the Lord was burning against his people, and he was angry with his heritage.
所以，耶和華的怒氣向他的百姓發作，憎惡他的產業，
He delivered them into the hand of the nations, and those who hated them ruled over them.
And he gave them into the hands of the nations; and they were ruled by their haters.
將他們交在外邦人的手裡；恨他們的人就轄制他們。
Their enemies oppressed them, and subdued them under their hand.
By them they were crushed, and made low under their hands.
他們的仇敵也欺壓他們，他們就伏在敵人手下。
Many times He rescued them, but they were bent on rebellion and sank down in their iniquity.
Again and again he made them free; but their hearts were turned against his purpose, and they were overcome by their sins.
他屢次搭救他們，他們卻設謀背逆，因自己的罪孽降為卑下。
Nevertheless He heard their cry; He took note of their distress.
But when their cry came to his ears, he had pity on their trouble:
然而，他聽見他們哀告的時候，就眷顧他們的急難，
And He remembered His covenant with them, and relented by the abundance of His loving devotion.
And kept in mind his agreement with them, and in his great mercy gave them forgiveness.
為他們記念他的約，照他豐盛的慈愛後悔。
He made them objects of compassion to all who held them captive.
He put pity into the hearts of those who made them prisoners.
他也使他們在凡擄掠他們的人面前蒙憐恤。
Save us, O LORD our God, and gather us from the nations, that we may give thanks to Your holy name, that we may glory in Your praise.
Be our saviour, O Lord our God, and let us come back together from among the nations, so that we may give honour to your holy name, and have glory in your praise.
耶和華─我們的神啊，求你拯救我們，從外邦中招聚我們，我們好稱讚你的聖名，以讚美你為誇勝。
Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Let all the people say, “Amen!” Hallelujah!
Praise be to the Lord God of Israel for ever and for ever; and let all the people say, So be it. Give praise to the Lord.
耶和華─以色列的神是應當稱頌的，從亙古直到永遠。願眾民都說：阿們！你們要讚美耶和華！
